# 1. Purpose and navigation

This file is the head of the specification: what the system is, what it measures, how a measurement connects to the world, and where each rule lives. Adopted decisions, proposed profiles, implemented mechanisms and tested results stay distinct; an implementation gap does not reopen a decision, and no document invents a missing physical law. The law's contract is [BEAM_LAW.md](BEAM_LAW.md); the names are [TERMINOLOGY.md](TERMINOLOGY.md); the engine's steps and record are [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md); the decisions are section 5.4; the mathematics is [DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md](DERIVATIONS_BEAM.md); the connection of clicks from Inside to Outside is [the click frame](designs/click_frame/DERIVATION.md); the registered readings are [EXPERIMENTS.md](EXPERIMENTS.md) and [NATURE.md](NATURE.md).

**The system on 2026-09-22.**

1. **The GameBoard.** One discrete world: the cubic lattice of Nodes, six Ports each in Port order +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z, a Link to each neighbour one unit step on one axis, the faces per axis open or periodic, an open face a detector named `face:+x` .. `face:-z` on which every row or body that leaves clicks; `GameBoard` in code, the only noun for it ([record 5](LOG_2026-09-20.md#05-decided-the-name-of-the-board-is-gameboard); [TERMINOLOGY, the location](TERMINOLOGY.md#the-location)). The whole of it is one state vector on the product torus, and nothing is outside it but the detectors' readings (the paragraph "The name" below; [record 181](LOG_2026-09-20.md#181-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0110z-the-owners-words-translated-so-the-system-becomes-vectors-tensors-and-operations-on-them-where-the-gameboard-checks-and-computes-when-there-is-a-limit-and-put-it-in-highlights-and-why-it-is-right-the-statement-the-state-is-integer-vectors-on-tori-a-row-a-record-a-bodys-counts-and-one-tensor-the-readings-order-2-moment-the-law-one-map-f-per-interval-at-every-node-made-of-six-operations-a-translation-by-a-rate-with-a-threshold-a-multiplication-by-a-declared-matrix-an-addition-an-inner-product-a-permutation-an-evaluation-and-the-gameboard-computes-exactly-where-the-formula-has-only-a-limit-a-constant-rate-gives-the-closed-form-floors_0--r-t-and-the-board-only-confirms-it-a-state-dependent-rate-gives-a-difference-equation-with-no-closed-form-whose-exact-solution-is-the-boards-iteration-and-whose-limit-is-the-derivations-differential-equation-the-measurement-the-one-threshold-read-out-why-it-holds-1-the-inventory-of-every-rule-of-beam-v1-finds-each-one-of-the-six-operations-or-a-declared-rounding-at-load-record-168-so-the-statement-is-a-fact-of-the-code-not-a-hope-2-the-two-steps-that-look-like-exceptions-are-not-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-is-a-bijection-z--zd-x-z-whose-carry-is-the-event-the-definition-of-a-whole-quantum-record-173-and-the-clicks-weight-is-the-inner-product-of-the-pointer-with-itself-through-the-couplings-primitive-record-173-so-nothing-is-squared-as-a-step-of-its-own-3-the-constant-rate-closed-form-reproduces-the-register-exactly-the-bell-cells-by-the-papers-s_of_n-the-cones-pins-before-its-run-the-64-registered-clicks-of-slits_low-by-the-map-record-156-so-computed-before-the-run-is-verified-4-the-feedback-class-has-no-closed-form-in-principle-the-rate-reads-the-state-so-the-iteration-is-the-only-exact-solution-and-the-boards-necessity-is-a-theorem-while-the-continuum-limit-is-the-derivations-and-the-pairing-checks-both-records-167-176-5-it-is-the-division-natures-t 2. **The state.** Between intervals a Node holds nothing but the rows present at it and the body there; a Node keeps no wave, no register, no remainder and no draw ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception); the third test, [record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)). A row, `NatureBeam`, the record of an event in transit: its Node, its direction (an index of the world's direction table), its age, its phase on the circle of N, its number, its amount and its content per unit; identical rows at one Node are one row with the amounts added ([BEAM_LAW section 2](BEAM_LAW.md#2-the-record-of-a-ray-and-the-world-file)). A body, a measured event, an event created here without end: its held content per family, its momentum vector **p** (the label, content x **u**_d per unit along its direction at the scale Q = 64), its phase, its clock (the count of its self-creations) and its counts table, one bounded accumulator per count with its remainder kept ([BEAM_LAW section 5](BEAM_LAW.md#5-the-detectors-record-the-re-emission-the-face-detectors), note 41; [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception)). 4. **The three tests and the contract.** A rule enters the law only if it is generic (one primitive with declared integers, a rate, a wall, a matrix or a table, no family name or kind, the engine branching on no name), vector (one of the six verbs, its rate at most bilinear in the state, no root, no float, no rounding at run time beyond the ones declared at load) and local (its own record and the six neighbours, fixed work and storage for a fixed K, nothing kept at a Node); a hypothesis that needs more is stated under its own identity outside the law ([record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201); **The name.** *Universe* is the one discrete world the simulator realises: the GameBoard of Nodes and Links with its Events, the whole of it one state vector on the product torus, and nothing outside it but the detector's reading; the framework is Reality Theory, the simulator Universe24 ([README](../README.md)). *24* is the number of rotations of that world's own symmetry: the six Ports of a Node are the six vertices of an octahedron, and the octahedron has exactly 24 rotations onto itself (and 24 more with a reflection, 48 in all, the two halves told apart by the hand); those 24 rotations are what the GameBoard has in place of the continuous rotation group, and a Lorentz boost, which mixes a space step with a time step, is not among them, which is why Lorentz's symmetry belongs to the limit and not to the group. On the GameBoard there are only events: a row is an event in transit, a body an event created here without end ([record 21](LOG_2026-09-20.md#21-and-there-is-no-ray-there-is-only-an-event)); the GameBoard is deterministic and the detectors' world is not ([record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world)); the API of the GameBoard is an emitter in and a detector out ([record 53](LOG_2026-09-20.md#53-decided-the-api-of-the-gameboard-is-an-emitter-in-and-a-detector-out)).

# 3. Foundational postulates

## 3.1 Discrete local space

The adopted board is a connected three-dimensional cubic network. Each local Node connects to six neighboring Nodes through directional Ports and Links. The GameBoard of a run is open on every face, what leaves clicking on the face detector; an axis may be declared periodic; a closed board is refused ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray)). NodeState is the unit of local state, and a Node keeps nothing beyond the events there: no register, no wave, no remainder and no draw ([record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception); section 1, item 2).

## 3.2 Ordinary Node dynamics are local

An ordinary Node operation uses only its own bounded state and information that has causally arrived through its Links. It cannot read another Node's live state or apply an instantaneous distant field, movement or inventory update. There is no exception for a detector: a detector is a declared set of measured events, Nodes like any other ([record 28 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#28-detector-as-physical-nodes-cell-sensitivity-and-information)); nothing returns and no number travels ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray)); the one non-local operation of the law is the click's gather at the apparatus's layer, at the one-way place, whose host cost the host pays ([record 74](LOG_2026-09-20.md#74-the-principles-of-amplitude-v1-in-ten-sentences); section 5.2). Section 3.18, which described a shared quantum-resource exception, was deleted on 2026-09-17.

## 3.3 Ray-form propagation is fundamental

There is no ray as a separate fundamental object and no ray-form propagation: the system has rows and bodies, not light and matter ([record 183](LOG_2026-09-20.md#183-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0120z-the-owners-words-translated-we-have-no-light-and-matter-in-the-system-but-and-yes-and-iii-too-in-parallel-one-motion-primitive-for-a-body-as-for-a-row-the-system-has-rows-of-any-family-and-bodies-measured-events-rows-fly-by-the-flight-table-euclidean-at-c-in-every-direction-a-bodys-drive-becomes-the-flight-table-on-its-momentums-primitive-direction-at-the-fraction-p--q-s-m--p-of-a-rows-pace-by_drivep-x-s_1-q-q-s-m--p-x-t_d-on-the-bresenham-line-of-d-one-accumulator-on-the-direction-in-place-of-one-per-axis-so-that-c-is-the-norm-of-the-flight-operator-for-everything-that-moves-no-body-outruns-a-row-the-motion-is-isotropic-and-the-two-motion-rules-of-the-system-become-one-and-lorentz-v1-in-parallel-the-rate-of-a-bodys-counts-its-turn-and-its-owed-count-multiplied-by-isqrtd2---p2--d-with-d--q-s-m--p-a-hypothesis-with-its-own-identity-stated-so-that-it-can-fail-its-test-the-muon-of-series-j4-both-built-by-the-no-tables-implementer-after-its-three-items-and-the-crossing-rule-from-the-mathematicians-light_speedformmd-with-the-moved-worlds-every-body-with-a-diagonal-momentum-walks-the-digital-line-instead-of-axis-staircases-the-orbit-series-d-bohrs-h-sun_planet-the-diagonal-throws-of-g2-every-body-above-c-on-an-axis-re-registered-once-and-the-physics-review-before-the-pull-request)); a row, `NatureBeam`, is the record of an event in transit on the digital line of its direction at one pace, its phase stamped by the emitter's clock at birth and turned per Link by its family's phase ## 3.4 Matter is emergent

There is no matter as a substance and no bound group of rays: a body is a measured event, created here without end, its held content per family, its momentum vector **p** (the momentum), its phase, its clock and its counts table ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); section 5.1, "The body"); the masses and the charges of the families are the initialisation, the catalog's declared contents and charge per unit, not derivable in this law ([record 106](LOG_2026-09-20.md#106-decided-the-masses-and-charges-are-the-initialisation-the-catalog-of-the-families-not-derivable-in-this-law-the-two-sentences-superseded-the-binding-design-pending)); the binding that costs content is the give at the contact, `binding-v1` ([record 143](LOG_2026-09-20.md#143-binding-v1-landed-pr-393-main-45c0eb48-the-physics-rule-review-mergeable-after-four-should-fix-none-blocking-the-rule-candidate-a-to-the-letter-and-every-pinned-integer-of-b1-b2-b3-reproduced-by-the-reviewers-own-replays-three-fixes-applied-before-the-merge-the-identity-and-given-from-the-run-time-give-the-designs-momentum-pin-outside-on-b1-by-270-720-on-x-exactly-6-x-3008-x-15-pushes-the-third-law-gap-of-record-126-made-visible-by-held-paid-content-that-counts-in-m_a-but-is-never-released-closed-once-both-gave-note-40s-readings-stated-b2s-amplitude-key-and-the-gate-replay-to-the-one-clicks-merge)).

## 3.6 One underlying physics

Classical, quantum and field descriptions concern one modeled system of Node properties, events and Links, not separate material worlds. The only measurement is a detector's click ([record 281](LOG_2026-09-20.md#281-the-owners-rule-most-readings-are-and-must-be-measurements-after-a-detector-the-skills-and-the-project-say-so-at-the-top-since-many-confuse-a-number-measured-on-the-gameboard-with-a-measurement-which-is-always-after-a-detector-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0615z-translated-also-make-sure-that-of-course-most-of-the-readings-are-exactly-after-a-detector-we-do-this-in-the-skills-and-in-the-project-too-many-get-confused-and-take-results-they-measured-but-that-is-a-measurement-after-a-detector-and-that-is-what-causes-many-problems-because-it-is-only-possible-to-measure-through-a-detector-what-stood-already-the-experimenter-measures-only-behind-a-detector-or-at-an-external-thing-skillsexperimenter-the-simulation-runner-labels-every-registered-number-a-detector-reading-or-a-gameboard-reading-skillssimulation-runner-the-shared-workflows-point-6-the-observed-value-is-the-reading-and-never-the-boards-number-record-210-enginemds-readings-by-type-record-205-57s-nobody-sees-the-state-the-54-line-of-record-277-added-now-so-that-every-role-reads-it-first-1-agentsmd-change-boundaries-one-bullet-a-measurement-is-a-detectors-reading-a-click-a-records-moments-an-external-things-reading-as-declared-in-the-world-file-only-a-measurement-is-compared-with-nature-or-pinned-as-an-expectation-a-gameboard-reading-the-hosts-view-of-stores-books-presences-and-phases-is-a-diagnostic-and-is-labelled-so-wherever-it-appears-a-number-whose-kind-is-not-named-is-not-a-result-2-skillsworkflowmd-under-record-205s-refinement-point-7-with-the-owners-words-and-the-same-rule-for-every-role-3-one-54-line-no-rule-of-the-law-changes-the-registers-labels-stand-record-163-5-the-pins-as-detector-readings-the-papers-confrontation-table-cites-only-detector-readings-and-says-so-record-275-2); section 3.19); the world is the list of clicks, and classical and quantum are the same GameBoard at a different density of clicks ([record 77](LOG_2026-09-20.md#77-the-corrected-sentence-without-a-caveat-and-the-wave)); the system has rows and bodies and no draw ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray), [record 183](LOG_2026-09-20.md#183-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0120z-the-owners-words-translated-we-have-no-light-and-matter-in-the-system-but-and-yes-and-iii-too-in-parallel-one-motion-primitive-for-a-body-as-for-a-row-the-system-has-rows-of-any-family-and-bodies-measured-events-rows-fly-by-the-flight-table-euclidean-at-c-in-every-direction-a-bodys-drive-becomes-the-flight-table-on-its-momentums-primitive-direction-at-the-fraction-p--q-s-m--p-of-a-rows-pace-by_drivep-x-s_1-q-q-s-m--p-x-t_d-on-the-bresenham-line-of-d-one-accumulator-on-the-direction-in-place-of-one-per-axis-so-that-c-is-the-norm-of-the-flight-operator-for-everything-that-moves-no-body-outruns-a-row-the-motion-is-isotropic-and-the-two-motion-rules-of-the-system-become-one-and-lorentz-v1-in-parallel-the-rate-of-a-bodys-counts-its-turn-and-its-owed-count-multiplied-by-isqrtd2---p2--d-with-d--q-s-m--p-a-hypothesis-with-its-own-identity-stated-so-that-it-can-fail-its-test-the-muon-of-series-j4-both-built-by-the-no-tables-implementer-after-its-three-items-and-the-crossing-rule-from-the-mathematicians-light_speedformmd-with-the-moved-worlds-every-body-with-a-diagonal-momentum-walks-the-digital-line-instead-of-axis-staircases-the-orbit-series-d-bohrs-h-sun_planet-the-diagonal-throws-of-g2-every-body-above-c-on-an-axis-re-registered-once-and-the-physics-review-before-the-pull-request)). A common framework and selected coupled experiments do not yet establish a complete derived unification of matter and fields.

## 3.7 Universal local laws

Equivalent local states with equivalent received inputs obey the same local rules, independent of position, total universe size or the labels assigned to an entity.

## 3.8 Causality has a finite speed

Ordinary physical propagation and transport cross adjacent Links at the finite causal speed bound c (the pace of a row). A new event cannot instantaneously move stock, change a distant ordinary field or erase a remote path. There is no returning ray; a row crosses at most one Link per interval, the flight's rate against its denominator ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [BEAM_LAW section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam)).

## 3.9 Fundamental propagation is local and stepwise

A physical ray advances only through connected neighboring Nodes. No physical trajectory may skip intermediate space.

## 3.10 Time is physical ordering

Model time orders local events and propagation in integer multiples of the minimum interval delta_t_min (the tick); no numerical SI value is assigned. The interval is the tick, GAMEBOARD, and a duration is a detector's reading of a clock ([record ## 3.11 Discrete physical state

Every value stored within a Node and every intermediate of a core operation is a signed bounded integer within the working bound, +-(2^63 - 1), never a register; a momentum component is signed; no floating point, roots or trigonometry at run time beyond the roundings declared at load ([record ## 3.12 Local bounded processing

Each Node performs one bounded local update per tick using bounded payloads and identifiers and six adjacent connections: the store's rows and fixed local storage and work ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [BEAM_LAW section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam)). Per-Node work and storage must not grow with world size or elapsed history. No growing queue, remote search or same-tick multi-Link push cascade is allowed. This is the third test of every rule, local: its own record and the six neighbours, fixed work and storage for a fixed K (the clock's pair), nothing kept at a Node ([record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)). History storage and total host work are accounted separately.

## 3.13 Interactions create observable properties

Properties attributed to a particle are inferred from how the underlying events interact: the interaction is the push, one bilinear form over the columns a family declares, and the click ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray), [record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard); section 5.3). A name such as electron, proton or mass does not itself supply a physical law or a hidden value; the engine branches on no name, the first test ([record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)).

## 3.14 No self-created force

An isolated closed physical structure cannot create net momentum from its own internal interactions. Local recoil is allowed only when an opposite momentum transfer is carried by rays or another explicitly owned local degree of freedom, so the total isolated system remains balanced: the recoil is taken at the release, and the books' momentum lines, held, in transit, escaped and turned, are exact at every interval ([record 10 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps); [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md)); nothing returns ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray)).

## 3.15 Conservation is local accounting

**Exact accounting.** Whenever a quantity is declared conserved, every local interaction and transfer must account for it exactly across all actual owners, including retained participants, products, recoil, fields, apparatus, in-flight values and remainders. A gain requires a corresponding loss, transfer or explicitly accounted source. Family and coupling definitions supply the physical readouts; the engine validates them without inventing energy or momentum from a label or computation-cost scalar. The accounting is the ledger per family, the measured, transit, content and charge lines and the momentum held, in transit, escaped and turned, balanced at every interval ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md); section 5.1, "The store and the books"); there is no return and no reconstruction.

## 3.16 Momentum is directional

Momentum and other vector quantities are conserved component by component. Preserving only speed or vector magnitude is not sufficient.

## 3.17 Remainders are physical bookkeeping

Discrete division or allocation must not silently destroy information or conserved quantity. Every indivisible remainder has an explicit bounded owner and lifecycle: every count of a body is an accumulator on its own record with its remainder kept and never discarded at run time, nothing at a Node ([record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception)); the rule stands for the host's bookkeeping outside the physics. An overflow or unsupported numerical representation rejects the operation before mutation; it must not silently round, clamp or drop an owner.

## 3.18 Deleted on 2026-09-17

This section described a shared quantum resource (Q-ORACLE-1) as an explicit exception to Bell-local factorization. The model owner deleted it on 2026-09-17: ordinary locality holds without exception. ## 3.19 Measurement is an interaction

A measurement is a detector's click, an action of the law on the state: the record ends at the detector, its content enters the detector's own record and its count advances ([record 1139](LOG_2026-09-20.md#1139-the-owner-which-fails-do-the-runs-solve-now-the-postulate-and-the-highlight-must-change-a-detector-does-not-only-read-it-performs-an-action-when-it-reads-a-clear-assumption-from-experiments-c-restated-as-that-check-whether-above-the-board-too-there-is-locality-and-discreteness-and-whether-it-follows-2026-09-23-1040z-recorded-by-the-boss-at-1040z-the-owner-013xz-in-hebrew-dictated-so-which-fail-will-the-runs-solve-now-and-then-by-4-we-need-to-change-one-of-our-postulates-right-so-maybe-already-now-the-whole-postulate-should-change-the-highlight-3-should-be-written-in-the-paper-i-think-but-you-know-that-it-does-not-only-read-so-there-is-nothing-to-stay-with-there-fix-it-it-does-when-it-reads-it-performs-an-action-right-it-must-perform-an-action-in-the-reading-and-that-is-the-whole-point-that-is-what-explains-that-a-detector-changes-the-outcome-and-this-we-know-it-is-a-clear-assumption-from-experiments-no-that-is-not-3-c-is-to-say-that-it-performs-an-action-you-do-not-only-read-you-also-perform-an-action-by-what-i-said-check-whether-one-can-say-that-above-the-board-too-there-is-locality-and-discreteness-see-whether-it-is-in-fact-an-assumption-that-follows-from-all-the-things-the-bosss-answers-and-acts-a-the-runs-now-can-turn-by-the-algebraists-table-as-read-ae-confirmed-4b-under-the-admitted-key-4a-in-form-within-the-domain-gamma--2-8b-and-8c-the-nu-quantum-1-the-class-filter-pins-13-in-the-limit-under-gamma_ppn--1-with-k_ab-read-by-a-lamp-14-if-the-moving-detectors-reading-holds-and-2a-settled-against-a-verified-two-slit-figure-six-or-seven-of-the-sixteen-the-others-need-a-rule-under-its-own-identity-or-lie-beyond-the-six-verbs-record-1129-c-b-the-click-an-action-the-owner-is-right-and-the-bosss-point-4-of-record-1134-is-withdrawn-as-worded-a-detector-does-not-only-read-its-click-is-an-action-of-the-law-on-the-state-the-record-ends-at-the-detector-its-content-enters-the-detectors-own-record-its-count-advances-which-is-what-the-papers-p11-a ## 3.20 Coherent alternatives and Detector-authorized outcomes

The GameBoard computes every possible future between click and click, and the next click chooses and adds a row to the list ([record 77](LOG_2026-09-20.md#77-the-corrected-sentence-without-a-caveat-and-the-wave)). In a recorded world the record is the identity a lamp's self-creation gives every row it births, carried through every split, re-emission, rotation and gate, one record one quantum, its rows its paths, its click one: the gather at the ladder, exactly one click per record ([record 86](LOG_2026-09-20.md#86-decided-amplitude-v1-is-built-with-the-four-recommendations-and-the-four-unifications); section 5.1, "The record of a quantum"; section 1, item 6). Replaying one committed Detector decision returns the same result without another draw, emission or inventory charge. Later calculation must preserve recorded history, not rewrite the past.

## 3.21 Emergence, not insertion

Large-scale laws must be derived from repeated local interactions. The desired macroscopic equation must not be inserted directly into the elementary update rule.

## 3.22 Scale independence

The same elementary laws apply in small test regions and in larger universes. Increasing the simulated size may add more Nodes and events, but it must not change the underlying local physics.

## 3.23 Symmetry is a requirement

Equivalent experiments under allowed shifts, orientations and other relevant transformations should produce equivalent physical behavior, subject only to genuine lattice effects that must be measured rather than hidden.

## 3.24 Geometry is relational

Spatial geometry is determined by the network of local connections and their propagation structure. Global coordinates are useful descriptions, not information required by local physics.

## 3.25 Complexity is emergent

Complex structures, apparent particles, material behavior and macroscopic laws must arise from repeated simple interactions among rays in local discrete space.

## 3.26 From symmetry groups to states and interactions on the board

Known symmetry groups and their representations constrain how property vectors transform and which couplings are allowed. A mathematical group is not a collection of moving objects: collections are interacting or correlated Node degrees of freedom whose propagation takes ray form. Generic definitions must specify the local participants, transformations, conserved quantities and output channels, rather than infer a law from an entity or interaction name. A force of nature is a column with a sign and a lifetime on its family, never a code path ([record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard)); the weak force is the transformation `become` on a body's own record, `weak-v1` ([record 78](LOG_2026-09-20.md#78-landed-the-weak-force-weak-v1-in-the-next-pull-request)); the strong force's range is a lifetime L on ## 3.27 Generic laws, symmetry and vector operations define board events

The design chain is: generic schema -> symmetry requirements -> scalar/vector and matrix operations -> events and Links in our spacetime. The same local rule applies to equivalent resident states and arrived inputs. Under allowed lattice transformations S, require F(SX, SI) = S F(X, I), or the corresponding equality of outcome distributions. A directed propagation pattern may break state symmetry without breaking law symmetry; generic code alone does not establish symmetry. Every proposed rule must identify where state is stored, what arrived, what operation acts, whether an outcome is recorded, how long it takes and what crosses each Link.

Observable records arise only from information that has causally reached the measuring system, not from an instantaneous view of the whole board.

```text
observed_description = Transform_frame(Readout(local_measurement_records))
```

Changing coordinates or basis changes an event's description; a measurement interaction may change state and record an outcome. These are distinct operations. Equivalent descriptions preserve declared invariants and consistent records. Every Outside formula carries its own transformation from an Inside formula, and a reading at another place is a detector at that place ([record ## 3.30 One property engine, from abstract structure to detector experience

The purpose of Universe24 is to turn abstract mathematical descriptions of groups, representations, particle families and their properties into explicit board dynamics and, through a modeled detector, observable experience. Abstract does not mean imaginary. The engine uses one generic state schema and operation framework: fields, electrons, muons and gluons are distinguished by property content, representations and permitted interactions, not by separate fundamental engines. A row is the record of an event in transit and a body a measured event, not additional entity classes ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray), [record 183](LOG_2026-09-20.md#183-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0120z-the-owners-words-translated-we-have-no-light-and-matter-in-the-system-but-and-yes-and-iii-too-in-parallel-one-motion-primitive-for-a-body-as-for-a-row-the-system-has-rows-of-any-family-and-bodies-measured-events-rows-fly-by-the-flight-table-euclidean-at-c-in-every-direction-a-bodys-drive-becomes-the-flight-table-on-its-momentums-primitive-direction-at-the-fraction-p--q-s-m--p-of-a-rows-pace-by_drivep-x-s_1-q-q-s-m--p-x-t_d-on-the-bresenham-line-of-d-one-accumulator-on-the-direction-in-place-of-one-per-axis-so-that-c-is-the-norm-of-the-flight-operator-for-everything-that-moves-no-body-outruns-a-row-the-motion-is-isotropic-and-the-two-motion-rules-of-the-system-become-one-and-lorentz-v1-in-parallel-the-rate-of-a-bodys-counts-its-turn-and-its-owed-count-multiplied-by-isqrtd2---p2--d-with-d--q-s-m--p-a-hypothesis-with-its-own-identity-stated-so-that-it-can-fail-its-test-the-muon-of-series-j4-both-built-by-the-no-tables-implementer-after-its-three-items-and-the-crossing-rule-from-the-mathematicians-light_speedformmd-with-the-moved-worlds-every-body-with-a-diagonal-momentum-walks-the-digital-line-instead-of-axis-staircases-the-orbit-series-d-bohrs-h-sun_planet-the-diagonal-throws-of-g2-every-body-above-c-on-an-axis-re-registered-once-and-the-physics-review-before-the-pull-request)). Uniform representation must retain physical differences, including charges, spin, statistics and couplings.

```text
property definitions + symmetry representations -> Node state -> propagation and interaction -> detector records -> observer-dependent display
```

At each Node, separately implemented generic operations evaluate owned properties and arrived inputs under immutable family/coupling definitions. The engine schedules, transports and validates; NodeState stores bounded data rather than physical formulas or executable expressions. Ordinary evolution is deterministic and nothing draws; the GameBoard is deterministic and the detectors' world is not ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray), [record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world)). What a detector reads is one of the readings by type: a scalar, an integer 3-vector in a declared unit, the traceless second-moment tensor **T** (the spread), or a record's phase-count vector **f** ([record 205](LOG_2026-09-20.md#205-decided-the-owner-in-the-architects-session-2026-09-21-the-owners-words-translated-note-that-we-will-want-to-run-experiments-so-we-must-understand-what-in-our-world-after-the-detector-connects-to-a-vector-value-and-in-what-form-and-everything-a-formula-can-give-let-it-give-in-a-run-only-prove-the-architects-framing-at-0222z-the-bosss-assignment-principle-a-after-the-detector-the-detector-reading-is-the-only-kind-reality-has-what-the-record-exposes-today-by-type-scalars-a-sets-record-per-family-the-clicks-and-measured-counts-a-sets-phase-a-clicks-phase-amount-content-and-u-a-bodys-content-phase-owed-and-age-vectors-each-an-integer-3-vector-in-a-declared-unit-p-the-momentum-vector-at-a-click-on-a-body-through-a-face-at-a-gather-and-on-the-books-lines-f-the-net-flow-vector-the-readings-first-moment-read-by-a-table-entry-with-reads-vector-a-node-as-a-position-the-tensor-t-the-traceless-second-moment-a-symmetric-3-x-3-integer-matrix-of-trace-zero-read-with-reads-tensor-the-one-rank-2-form-and-the-contracts-limit-pairs-a-gathers-weight-and-total-in-the-unit-258-a-bodys-charges-per-column-the-gap-the-record-exposes-the-pointers-square-and-its-phase-but-no-vector-form-of-a-direction-on-the-circle-the-architects-a1-expose-x-y-is-corrected-by-the-boss-under-item-1b-the-vector-of-a-record-is-its-phase-count-vector-f-in-zn-of-which-the-pointer-is-the-image-e-f-so-what-an-experiment-may-read-as-a-vector-on-the-circle-is-f-or-e-f-derived-from-it-decided-with-the-records-form-item-2-of-record-203-a2-the-table-the-detectors-readings-by-type-in-enginemd-and-experimentsmd-every-quantity-with-its-symbol-unit-and-field-so-that-an-experiment-names-the-vector-it-will-read-before-the-run-the-architect-now-principle-b-a-formula-gives-a-run-proves-the-expectation-of-every-experiment-is-derived-from-the-laws-integer-operations-before-the-run-the-operator-f-its-exact-identities-the-tables-closed-forms-and-registered-with-its-derivation-beside-the-number-the-run-comp [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md#the-detectors-readings-by-type)). A Recorder stores evidence and a Renderer presents it. The material-eye and full species-dynamics goals remain separate from supported profiles; a visualization does not establish agreement with nature.

# 4. Central statement

Universe24 investigates one discrete Node-and-Link world, the GameBoard, in which there are only events, a row an event in transit and a body a measured event ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [record 21](LOG_2026-09-20.md#21-and-there-is-no-ray-there-is-only-an-event)); the statement of the system today is section 1, "The system on 2026-09-22". Ordinary dynamics are local and deterministic; there is no draw, no shared resource, no hidden ordinary access and no second material world. Symmetry representations constrain generic property operations. Every mechanism must specify local state, arrivals, operations, owners and causal transfers. The aim is to derive and test effective behavior without inserting the desired macroscopic laws. A defined contract or configured experiment is not yet a complete derived theory of nature.

# 5. Reading map

## 5.1 Node state and ray form

**The location.** A Node is one location of the GameBoard, six Ports in Port order and a Link to each neighbour; its NodeState is all the local information it owns at an interval, the records of the rows present and of the body there, and nothing else: no wave, no lane, no slot, no parked share, no register ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray); [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception); [TERMINOLOGY, the location](TERMINOLOGY.md#the-location)). p-1-records-the-tie-as-declared-but-not-as-a-breaking-beam_law-section-4-and-formmd-section-3-call-the-collisions-port-order-tie-the-one-undeclared-breaking-routed-as-text-the-same-hour-terminologys-entry-by-the-boss-this-pr-covariant-up-to-the-two-declared-ties-the-lines-axis-order-and-the-collisions-port-order-note-39s-closing-and-section-4-by-the-architect-12-step-1-by-the-derivation-mathematician-the-alternative-a-tie-broken-by-a-datum-of-the-row-and-not-by-the-axis-index-is-a-rule-change-and-is-put-to-the-owner-on-the-gameboard-rule-329-round-3-approved-the-pace-bound-on-a-fan-on-the-290-directions-within-manhattan-6-on-mains-per-axis-drive-the-pin-first-then-the-collisions-tie-on-a-world-of-singles)).

**The row.** `NatureBeam`, the record of an event in transit, one row per record in the store: its Node, its direction (0 and 1 the rest directions, 2 to 7 the six headings in Port order, 8 onward the declared primitive vectors within the bound P), its age since the event that created it, kept whole, its phase on the circle Z_N stamped by the emitter's clock at birth and turned by its family's `phase_per_link` at every Link, its number (the last emitter's), its amount and its content per unit (h x s for a paid family, 0 for a free one); its momentum is not stored but is its label, content x **u**_d per unit along the unit vector of its direction at the scale Q = 64, and its hand is a pseudoscalar carried unchanged ([BEAM_LAW section 2](BEAM_LAW.md#2-the-record-of-a-ray-and-the-world-file), notes 18, 23, 25, 39). In a recorded world it carries its record's number, its branch and its multiplicity, and rows of one record in antiphase cancel at the merge (note 37). A row is a body of no content: the first test.

**The body.** A measured event, created here without end, at one Node or on a set of Nodes (`span`): its held content per family (its content the sum, its charge per column the rational sum over what it holds), its momentum vector **p** in label units, its phase, its clock (the count of its self-creations, its age) and its counts table, one row per count with one bounded accumulator each, the owed count, the release per family, the lamp's wheel, the turn, the push per column and axis, the drive, the action and the place rows; every count is the whole part its accumulator yields against its denominator and the remainder stays on the record ([BEAM_LAW section 5](BEAM_LAW.md#5-the-detectors-record-the-re-emission-the-face-detectors), notes 31, 41, 46; [record 155](LOG_2026-09-20.md#155-decided-the-owner-2330z-go-for-it-no-registers-at-nodes-no-tables-the-owners-words-translated-on-the-bosss-summary-of-how-the-law-becomes-integers-and-vectors-alone-1-the-counts-as-the-accumulator-vector-on-the-record-built-record-154-2-the-flight-table-as-the-positions-accumulator-per-axis-the-name-retired-3-the-last-two-divisions-the-push-by-share-the-apportioning-over-a-set-under-the-same-rule-with-the-leftover-on-the-givers-record-4-the-crossing-rule-at-the-step-and-the-deletion-of-doppler-v1-with-g-records-151-153-5-the-meeting-verbs-derived-from-the-families-keys-no-family-table-the-mathematicians-open-item-of-record-40-6-the-clicks-c-and-s-computed-from-n-as-a-declared-rounding-or-the-integer-circle-if-the-mathematicians-two-slit-answer-asks-for-it-record-152-7-the-registers-pins-as-detector-readings-only-and-bohrs-turn-under-action-joins-the-counts-no-exception), [record 180](LOG_2026-09-20.md#180-the-wheel-as-the-generic-vector-form-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0105z-the-owners-words-translated-the-wheel-was-also-turned-into-a-generic-vector-wasnt-it-the-bosss-yes-taken-as-the-decision-on-record-163-3-the-birth-wheel-is-one-row-of-the-counts-table-on-the-lamps-record-acc--2531-acc-mod-4096-the-translation-on-the-torus-z--4096-that-every-count-is-the-lamp-writes-the-rows-value-on-the-record-at-birth-as-u-at-the-click-the-cells-cumulative-weights-are-sums-the-rungs-2-w-c_k--t--2-t-one-declared-rounding-and-the-choice-u--b_k-the-wall-test-so-the-whole-click-is-a-multiplication-by-declared-matrices-an-addition-an-inner-product-and-a-threshold-no-step-of-its-own-the-map-record-164-showed-the-same-clicks-as-the-bit-reversed-ordinal-within-one-click-at-4096-births-physically-the-lamps-phase-at-the-moment-of-birth-at-a-rate-incommensurate-with-its-birth-rate-built-as-item-3-of-the-click-pull-request-after-the-exact-phase)). A body moves by its momentum, one Link per self-creation at most; a fixed body never steps and takes every push into its momentum; a body is an emitter (a lamp, a release) and a detector at its own Node ([record 569](LOG_2026-09-20.md#569-the-owners-word-an-emitter-behaves-as-a-detector-too-within-its-limits-a-fixed-body-is-both-2026-09-22-about-0014z-recorded-by-the-boss-the-reviewers-question-of-record-567-a-fixed-body-without-a-lamp-both-self-creates-rays-an-emitter-and-reads-what-arrives-a-detector-put-to-the-owner-with-the-bosss-proposed-answer-both-by-the-role-of-each-act-the-owner-translated-yes-an-emitter-behaves-like-a-detector-right-with-its-limitations-the-decision-every-external-entity-is-a-detector-or-an-emitter-and-an-emitter-is-also-a-detector-at-its-own-node-within-its-limits-it-reads-only-what-arrives-at-it-the-clicks-at-its-node-or-faces-its-declared-reads-such-as-age-never-a-store-elsewhere-what-it-emits-is-an-emitters-act-what-it-reads-is-a-detectors-reading-and-a-fixed-body-is-both-the-registers-labels-of-a-bodys-clock-and-momentum-as-detector-readings-stand-enginemds-table-one-highlights-line-added-extending-the-line-of-record-562-the-reviewers-question-is-closed-by-this-word-no-file-of-the-register-changes-for-it)).

**The record of a quantum.** In a recorded world, the identity a lamp's self-creation gives every row it births, carried through every split, re-emission, rotation and gate; one record is one quantum of the world's list of clicks, its rows its paths, its click one; in the vector form the record is the phase-count vector **f** of Z^N per end Node and label, an element of the group ring Z[Z_N] ([record 86](LOG_2026-09-20.md#86-decided-amplitude-v1-is-built-with-the-four-recommendations-and-the-four-unifications), [record 188](LOG_2026-09-20.md#188-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0140z-the-owners-words-translated-yes-if-it-cleans-a-non-vector-operation-off-the-gameboard-the-click-without-amplitudes-on-the-bosss-answer-to-the-owners-question-is-there-a-vector-operation-that-replaces-the-amplitudes-the-record-is-the-phase-count-vector-f-in-zn-the-amplitude-x-y--e-f-with-e-the-2-x-n-matrix-of-the-rounded-cosine-and-sine-rows-the-weight-x2--y2--ft-g-f-with-g--et-e-the-gram-matrix-one-bilinear-form-on-the-record-bit-identical-by-the-associativity-of-integer-arithmetic-the-arms-products-bell-ghz-the-multiplication-in-the-group-ring-zz_n-a-convolution-and-the-label-rotation-the-same-in-zz_2n-the-coherent-sum-within-a-node-tuple-and-the-incoherent-sum-across-tuples-one-block-diagonal-g-so-the-click-is-convolutions-and-additions-in-the-ring-one-bilinear-form-and-one-threshold-and-the-complex-numbers-zi-cmul-leave-the-code-the-form-is-the-lattice-gleasons-at-c_1--1-record-185-the-host-cost-n2-per-cell-for-2-n-the-owners-yes-conditional-on-the-change-removing-a-non-vector-operation-from-the-gameboard-which-it-does-the-evaluation-into-zi-and-the-complex-product-are-replaced-by-the-rings-convolution-and-the-one-bilinear-form-built-as-item-1b-of-the-click-pull-request-by-the-click-implementer-bit-identical-no-re-registration-the-derivation-mathematicians-67-ordered-before-the-decision-proves-the-identity-and-checks-it-integer-by-integer-on-mz_equal-slits_low-and-the-bell-cells-the-owners-question-of-the-same-message-what-is-the-input-of-the-whole-story-the-mass-n-and-g-and-something-else-what-is-our-input-to-our-physical-world-and-what-is-the-input-to-the-real-world-answered-in-record-189); BEAM_LAW note 37).

**The store and the books.** The host's arrays, one row per record per family, sorted by Node at every interval, and the ledger per family exact at every interval (the measured, transit, content and charge lines and the momentum held, in transit, escaped and turned); both are the host's reports, GAMEBOARD, never a thing of the law ([BEAM_LAW section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam); [ENGINE.md](ENGINE.md)).

**The families in place of layers.** What the older text called a layer is the family table: families a body's table does not name pass it (`pass`), the crowd a reader reads is everything at its Node but its own number, and a row of one family meets a body only through that body's entry for the family ([record 18 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#18-i-approve-1-and-3-and-2-with-the-physicist); BEAM_LAW note 47, [record ## 5.2 Generic operations at a Node

**The interval.** One function, `nature_beam`, performs a Node's whole interval for the rows present, in six named steps and nothing else with law in it ([BEAM_LAW, "The owner's name"](BEAM_LAW.md#the-beam-law-beam-v1); [section 3](BEAM_LAW.md#3-the-nodes-interval-nature_beam)): (1) `_walk`, departures become arrivals, every row whose flight counts a Link crosses it whole, its record unchanged, the row and the body meeting once at the crossing of their world lines ([record 158](LOG_2026-09-20.md#158-the-crossing-rule-designed-record-153s-order-the-physicist-read-only-scratchpad-crossingdesignmd-with-crossing_simpy-main-unchanged-a-row-and-a-body-meet-once-at-the-crossing-of-their-world-lines-a-body-at-rest-reads-arrivals-as-today-in-the-interval-of-a-step-it-also-meets-the-rows-that-crossed-its-own-link-the-other-way-and-the-rows-resident-at-the-destination-moving-against-it-and-it-does-not-meet-the-rows-moving-with-it-the-rows-behind-it-on-its-link-or-one-interval-later-the-rows-it-met-at-the-origin-the-leapfrog-the-bodys-own-two-last-links-are-the-only-facts-nothing-at-a-node-proved-on-the-experimenters-streams-toward-k--4-45-reads-in-32-intervals-k--8-58-in-48-away-19-in-32-38-in-48-rest-48-no-row-twice-none-missed-the-integer-form-moves-_move-before-the-law-and-makes-met-the-crossing-expression-doppler-v1-and-g-deleted-with-the-list-the-emergent-doppler-exact-on-the-axis-and-the-transverse-an-encounter-count-on-a-fan-direction-a-limit-to-state-not-to-tune-admissible), note 48); (2) `_collide`, at a Node of free space the permutation of the directions of the single rows of one (Node, number, content) group by the eight-slot table, a bijection ([section 4](BEAM_LAW.md#4-the-collision-table)); (3) `_measure`, every body reads the one reading set at its Nodes (the amount-weighted moments of order 0, 1 and 2 of the arrivals' unit vectors and the age moment) and applies its table per family, `read` (the push taken, the rows go on), `measure` (the click), `rerelease` (taken, to be created again), `pass`, or `become` (the transformation, `weak-v1`); (4) `_release`, at a self-creation a body releases what its table and its lamp say, every unit priced by the turn, E = h f, apportioned whole over its directions with the recoil taken ([record 10 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps)); (5) `_border`, the escape through an open face and the border `lifetime` booked as clicks; (6) `_merge`, identical rows at one Node become one row with the amounts added, antiphase rows of one record cancelling. Before the steps the engine's frame reads the measured events' steps (the drive per axis) and after them the clocks' turn and count ([MIGRATION, the interval in named steps](MIGRATION.md#the-interval-in-named-steps-on-2026-09-21-host-only-bit-exact)). Every step is one of the six verbs on the state vector: the flight, the phase, the age and every count are translations of an accumulator by its rate; the push and the click's weight are bilinear forms with declared matrices; the merge is the group-ring addition; the collision and the gate are permutations; the tables at the click are the evaluation at the N-th root of unity; the carry of every count and the one threshold of the click are the Euclidean division with the remainder kept ([record 181](LOG_2026-09-20.md#181-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0110z-the-owners-words-translated-so-the-system-becomes-vectors-tensors-and-operations-on-them-where-the-gameboard-checks-and-computes-when-there-is-a-limit-and-put-it-in-highlights-and-why-it-is-right-the-statement-the-state-is-integer-vectors-on-tori-a-row-a-record-a-bodys-counts-and-one-tensor-the-readings-order-2-moment-the-law-one-map-f-per-interval-at-every-node-made-of-six-operations-a-translation-by-a-rate-with-a-threshold-a-multiplication-by-a-declared-matrix-an-addition-an-inner-product-a-permutation-an-evaluation-and-the-gameboard-computes-exactly-where-the-formula-has-only-a-limit-a-constant-rate-gives-the-closed-form-floors_0--r-t-and-the-board-only-confirms-it-a-state-dependent-rate-gives-a-difference-equation-with-no-closed-form-whose-exact-solution-is-the-boards-iteration-and-whose-limit-is-the-derivations-differential-equation-the-measurement-the-one-threshold-read-out-why-it-holds-1-the-inventory-of-every-rule-of-beam-v1-finds-each-one-of-the-six-operations-or-a-declared-rounding-at-load-record-168-so-the-statement-is-a-fact-of-the-code-not-a-hope-2-the-two-steps-that-look-like-exceptions-are-not-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-is-a-bijection-z--zd-x-z-whose-carry-is-the-event-the-definition-of-a-whole-quantum-record-173-and-the-clicks-weight-is-the-inner-product-of-the-pointer-with-itself-through-the-couplings-primitive-record-173-so-nothing-is-squared-as-a-step-of-its-own-3-the-constant-rate-closed-form-reproduces-the-register-exactly-the-bell-cells-by-the-papers-s_of_n-the-cones-pins-before-its-run-the-64-registered-clicks-of-slits_low-by-the-map-record-156-so-computed-before-the-run-is-verified-4-the-feedback-class-has-no-closed-form-in-principle-the-rate-reads-the-state-so-the-iteration-is-the-only-exact-solution-and-the-boards-necessity-is-a-theorem-while-the-continuum-limit-is-the-derivations-and-the-pairing-checks-both-records-167-176-5-it-is-the-division-natures-theories-have-linear-evolution-between-measurements-the-nonlinear-classical-limit-one-read-out-and-the-laws-numbers-quantise-exactly-what-lives-on-a-compact-group-predictions-26-record-179-what-the-law-does-not-reach-is-stated-in-the-same-terms-the-contraction-gamma-needs-is-a-root-of-the-state-not-one-of-the-six-record-178), [record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201); section 5.7).

**The tables are generated, not written.** A body's rule per family is generated from the families' keys, a free family read and a paid one measured; a world declares only what differs: a window, a `rerelease` with its directions and weights, a `pass`, a `become`, a `reads` component ([record 18 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#18-i-approve-1-and-3-and-2-with-the-physicist)). The engine branches on no family's name, kind or physical word, the first test; every rule is one primitive with declared integers serving every family, and a family's special cases are values and not branches ([record 202](LOG_2026-09-20.md#202-decided-the-owner-2026-09-21-about-0235z-the-owners-words-translated-put-the-three-tests-as-a-very-important-principle-in-the-skill-and-in-the-highlights-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-the-admission-test-of-the-law-a-rule-enters-the-law-only-if-it-is-1-generic-one-primitive-with-declared-integers-a-rate-a-wall-a-matrix-a-table-and-no-family-name-or-kind-the-same-primitive-serving-every-family-its-special-cases-values-and-not-branches-a-row-is-a-body-of-no-content-the-engine-branching-on-no-name-2-vector-one-of-the-six-verbs-on-the-state-vector-the-translation-of-an-accumulator-by-its-rate-the-bilinear-form-with-a-declared-matrix-the-group-ring-addition-the-permutation-the-evaluation-the-euclidean-division-with-the-remainder-kept-its-rate-at-most-bilinear-in-the-state-no-root-no-float-no-rounding-at-run-time-beyond-the-ones-declared-at-load-3-local-reading-only-its-own-record-and-the-six-neighbouring-nodes-fixed-work-and-storage-for-a-fixed-k-nothing-kept-at-a-node-every-host-reading-labelled-host-a-rule-that-fails-one-test-does-not-enter-the-law-and-a-hypothesis-that-needs-more-a-seventh-verb-is-stated-under-its-own-identity-outside-the-law-until-it-passes-or-the-owner-admits-the-verb-written-as-highlightsmd-54s-line-and-57s-paragraph-skillsworkflowmds-section-the-three-tests-of-every-rule-one-section-in-every-roles-skill-and-a-bullet-in-agentsmds-change-boundaries-form-b-was-the-first-rule-read-against-the-three-record-201)). Nothing at a Node holds state beyond the events there, the GameBoard is O(1) per Node, and the apparatus's layer that holds the live records is at the one-way place, the only non-local operation, whose host cost is paid by the host ([record 74](LOG_2026-09-20.md#74-the-principles-of-amplitude-v1-in-ten-sentences)).

**The contract.** Every physical change follows the [local integer operation contract](ARCHITECTURE.md#local-integer-operation-contract): generic law ownership, integer intermediates, causal inputs, formula-free payloads; and [LOCALITY-1](../SIMULATOR_DEFINITIONS.md#locality-1-end-to-end-local-physics): fixed local work and storage for a fixed K, six neighbours, no global estimator; a diagnostic may reject a run and never repairs its state. A test exercises one generic rule on a minimal GameBoard with its integers pinned before the first run; a milestone is one fingerprinted run, never a suite ([section 5.5](#55-acceptance-tests-and-open-decisions); [skills/workflow.md](../skills/workflow.md)).

## 5.3 Couplings, fields and timing

**The one coupling.** There is no field: a field is the crowd of rows a body reads at its Node ([record 2 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#02-the-law-of-events-no-fields-no-matter-no-registers-only-events)). What a body takes from the rows arriving at its Nodes is the push, the signed inner product over the columns a family declares per unit of content, per column the whole part off the reader's clock of the label flow **V** times the reader's charge in the column times the arriving family's value: gravity every family's first column, charge the second, a paid family's rows giving the label itself; the bilinear form **C** **a** with **C** the reader's charges; a force of nature is a column with a sign and a lifetime on its family, never a code path ([record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard), [record 35](LOG_2026-09-20.md#35-the-mathematicians-verdict-on-the-columns-correct-and-working); BEAM_LAW note 31; `columns-v1`). A release costs the emitter by its phase rate, E = h f with h the family's declared `quantum` ([record 10 of ## 5.4 The Detector

The law in force is the Beam Law, `beam-v1`, decided on 2026-09-19 (the law of the ray; its published design and implementation contract is [BEAM_LAW.md](BEAM_LAW.md)); with `amplitude-v1` (decided 2026-09-20; [its design](designs/amplitude-v1/DESIGN.md)) the law of every world with a lamp since the one click of the same day, the world key `amplitude` deleted then ([record 135](LOG_2026-09-20.md#135-stage-vii-step-4-built-on-the-branch-the-one-click-the-record-form-the-law-every-lamp-births-records-the-key-amplitude-deleted-the-crowd-threshold-deleted-the-8-lamp-free-gate-worlds-byte-identical-to-main-the-7-lamp-worlds-changed-by-the-record-form-itself-the-stop-rule-read-as-the-crowd-threshold-series--every-lamp-world-the-k-table-unchanged-the-share-worlds-integers-as-expected-w27_beams-host-cost-7-gb-not-completed-the-gate-review-running), [record 145](LOG_2026-09-20.md#145-the-one-click-landed-pr-395-main-e4b649a0-stage-vii-step-4-of-amplitude-v1-under-record-137-1-and-2-every-lamp-births-records-one-click-per-record-by-the-ladder-u-the-records-own-field-the-push-by-share-the-key-amplitude-deleted-as-built-the-gate-reviews-three-items-closed-b-the-layer-releases-a-gathered-records-offers-bit-identical-on-14-of-14-completed-gate-worlds-and-the-four-k-worlds-w27_beams-memory-bounded-at-33-gb-but-its-time-open-c-a1s-verdict-from-the-gathers-the-ladder-lands-five-u-alone-on-the-screen-no-record-visibility-formed-the-gate-set-of-sixteen-all-and-only-the-lamp-worlds-changed-b2-re-run-under-the-one-click-with-its-binding-pins-unchanged-the-fraction-free-unification-started-from-its-head-the-architects-pr-3-and-phase-2-signalled); [BEAM_LAW note 37 (x)](BEAM_LAW.md#10-implementation-notes-2026-09-19-the-implementation)). ### Decisions of 2026-09-21

- **Computation without an accumulator** (the model owner, 2026-09-21, "does the system allow computation without an accumulator at all?"): yes where the rate is constant, the closed form and the accumulator bit-identical (u = ordinal x 2531 mod 4096 the closed form of the lamp's count; the exact phase at the click a function of the row's age and direction), parting only where a rate varies (the lamp's turn under E = h f, the crowd's owed count); the three two-slit fixes computation only; ### Decisions of 2026-09-20

- **`wave` is the default reading of a detector, `beam` a declared option**; Bell must read S = 2 unchanged under it -- [record 02](LOG_2026-09-20.md#02-decided-wave-is-the-default-reading-of-a-detector-beam-a-declared-option); supersedes [record 24 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#24-decided-the-detector-key-reading-beam-by-default-the-pairing-rule-and-wave-the-coherent-sum-an-option) (`beam` by default); under `amplitude-v1`, `sum` is the reading of the one pointer over a record, `wave` over the crowd, one scope key (unification 4, record 86).
- **The principle**: "on the game board a ray, and in the world a wave is received", the standing statement of the model -- [record 03](LOG_2026-09-20.md#03-the-principle-on-the-gameboard-a-ray-in-the-world-a-wave); read since the evening as a statement about a crowd: the sum the click reads is over the rows of one record, and the wave is the form the list of clicks draws ([record 77](LOG_2026-09-20.md#77-the-corrected-sentence-without-a-caveat-and-the-wave)). Restated on 2026-09-22 by records 762 and 768: Inside the GameBoard a beam by the law's algebraic formulas, Outside the amplitudes' passage, the wave the form the list of clicks draws.
- **The name of the board is GameBoard** ("that is what it is to be called in English in every place, also in the code: GameBoard") -- [record 05](LOG_2026-09-20.md#05-decided-the-name-of-the-board-is-gameboard); landed with the names, record 44.
- **Series G, the Hubble diagram behind the detector** ("let it check whether what is observed today is also seen in our detector") -- [record 10](LOG_2026-09-20.md#10-decided-series-g-the-hubble-diagram-behind-the-detector); landed, record 32; its "surprise" is not a finding, record 60.

the gallery's pages and tool went with the thin worlds, and a page is made only for what the paper needs.
- **The GameBoard is deterministic; the detector's world is not**, by the uncertainty principle in the detector's world -- [record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world).
- **Two kinds of readings**: a detector reading, the only kind reality has, and a GameBoard reading, the host's view ("In reality there is no such thing"); a comparison with nature uses detector readings only -- [record 20](LOG_2026-09-20.md#20-decided-two-kinds-of-readings-in-reality-there-is-no-such-thing).
- **The experimenter's skill**: every real experiment measures behind a detector or at an external thing; "the GameBoard is not measurable by a human" -- [record 22](LOG_2026-09-20.md#22-decided-the-experimenters-skill-the-gameboard-is-not-measurable-by-a-human).
- **The strong force's range is a lifetime, L** ("excellent, go for it"): a family key counted on the event's own age; the event whose age reaches L makes no next event but an escape click in the ledger -- [record 23](LOG_2026-09-20.md#23-decided-the-strong-forces-range-is-a-lifetime-l); the strong force landed as series I, record 61.
- **The weak force is arranged in the world's terms, and the law is asked what else it predicts** ("Arrange the weak force according to our world, and check whether we predict more things") -- [record 25](LOG_2026-09-20.md#25-decided-the-weak-force-is-arranged-in-the-worlds-terms-and-the-law-is-asked-what-else-it-predicts); the physicist's design, record 36; landed as `weak-v1`, record 78.
- **"Our laws are on the GameBoard; in the detector one sees other laws"**: a comparison with nature is always between detector readings and nature's laws, never between the GameBoard's rules and nature's laws -- [record 26](LOG_2026-09-20.md#26-decided-our-laws-are-on-the-gameboard-in-the-detector-one-sees-other-laws).
- **One mechanism for all the laws on the GameBoard** ("maybe one mechanism for all the laws on the board?"; "just check that it is correct and that it works"): the one coupling a signed inner product over the columns a family declares per unit of content, gravity the column every family has -- [record 27](LOG_2026-09-20.md#27-decided-one-mechanism-for-all-the-laws-on-the-gameboard); the mathematician's verdict on the columns, record 35.
- **The catalog of the entities**: every entity physics knows is one row of the law's keys, the external things placeable on the GameBoard as detector-emitters, the Outside (2026-09-23, [record ### Decisions of 2026-09-19

- **One speed**: "A quantum passes, like everything, at the speed of light between Nodes"; what we see are events, and only through a Detector -- [record 01](LOG_2026-09-19.md#01-one-speed-and-what-is-seen).
- **"I approve the proposal"**: a release costs the emitter by its phase rate, E = h f with h the declared `quantum`; the two gaps recorded -- [record 10](LOG_2026-09-19.md#10-i-approve-the-proposal-a-release-costs-the-emitter-e--h-f-the-two-gaps).
- The click is the only one-way border, and an open face of the GameBoard is a detector (what leaves is a click on the face detector; an axis may be periodic; a closed board is refused; [record 15](LOG_2026-09-20.md#15-decided-the-gameboard-is-deterministic-the-detectors-world-is-not-by-the-uncertainty-in-the-detectors-world), superseding the closed board of [record 20](LOG_2026-09-20.md#20-decided-two-kinds-of-readings-in-reality-there-is-no-such-thing)); the rest of the law of the ray of 2026-09-19 ('there is no wave in the Node'; a unit a ray with a record on the digital line of its momentum at one speed; named the Beam Law on 2026-09-20) is superseded on 2026-09-23 by the local detector law: the record's rows at Nodes split at every free Node, and the amplitudes are the record's, never the Node's ([record ### Decisions of 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-18 (superseded on 2026-09-19 by the law of the ray)

Every decision of these two days, the Detector's bit as a property of the ray ([record 3 of 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md#03-the-detectors-bit-is-a-property-of-the-ray)), a click as an absorption ([record 4 of 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md#04-a-click-is-an-absorption)), the law of the bit with its definitions, its points 15 to 25 and the five rules settled, "a thing does not emit" then "a thing emits" ([record 7 of 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md#07-the-law-of-the-bit-the-thing-or-its-shadow) to record 26), the law of the shadow, only shadows and events ([record 29 of 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md#29-the-law-of-the-shadow-only-shadows-and-events)), and the closed board of a run with K a constant ([record 20 of 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md#20-the-board-of-a-run-is-closed-and-k-is-a-constant)), was superseded on 2026-09-19 by the law of the ray ([record 15 of 2026-09-19](LOG_2026-09-19.md#15-decided-the-law-of-the-ray)): rows and bodies, no bit, no shadow, no draw, no return, the GameBoard of a run open on every face. The records are in [the log of 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-18](LOG_2026-09-18.md).

**How to add a record.** A record of a day (a reading, a finding, a run, a proposal, a question, the owner's words) is appended to `docs/LOG_<date>.md` under the next `### NN.` heading, never to this section; only a decision of the model owner is added here, as one line under its date with a link to its record. A number is never reused or moved, and a record is never edited; a line of this section that a later decision or the code as built superseded is deleted, its record staying in the log and the deletion naming the record in [the deletions table](designs/highlights_one_version/DELETIONS.md) ([record 1244](LOG_2026-09-20.md#1244-the-owners-four-answers-the-plan-fine-row-13-and-row-8a-fix-the-highlights-rule-changed-what-is-outdated-is-deleted-no-supplement-one-paper-the-light-clock-excellent-use-it-arrange-it-2026-09-23-0404z-recorded-by-the-boss-at-0408z-the-owners-word-hebrew-dictated-item-by-item-on-the-bosss-six-lines-of-0356z-1-one-fine-the-plan-of-record-1241-stands-2-two-fix-row-13s-number-in-the-paper-and-in-naturemd-the-writers-commit-17-and-the-architects-nature-fold-3-already-ordered-record-1237-and-row-8as-missing-reading-in-the-laboratorys-clock-a-row-8a-runner-opened-session_015cvkbwfcs8kkbp9cjsjavg-0406z-branch-row-8a-clock-step-1-the-pins-before-any-run-the-shell-detectors-own-count-under-clock_stamp-on-a-copy-of-the-j1-world-with-that-one-key-added-the-registers-world-untouched-the-run-only-after-a-reviewers-gate-and-the-bosss-go-3-three-change-the-rule-so-that-deleting-is-allowed-what-is-outdated-delete-change-the-rule-the-highlights-rule-of-records-802-and-941-a-superseded-line-marked-and-pointed-never-deleted-is-superseded-an-outdated-line-of-highlights-is-deleted-its-record-staying-in-the-log-the-log-is-never-cut-and-the-deletion-naming-the-record-applied-now-by-the-boss-the-heads-item-11-no-longer-says-on-main-the-bending-of-light-reads-0-but-the-laws-number-at-head-record-1237--1993-pixel-at-gamma_ppn-0-on-opticalmass_g0-against-control_g0-detector-the-pin-met-half-of-natures-1--gamma-a-factor-2-the-rules-three-statements-the-pruning-rule-row-of-the-system-table-the-decision-lines-of-records-802-and-941-rewritten-to-the-new-rule-the-valid-parts-kept-the-head-is-the-system-now-54-the-trail-every-agent-cuts-from-its-own-file-what-no-longer-applies-the-highlights-auditors-old-question-record-927-whether-54-lines-may-be-deleted-answered-yes-when-outdated-4-four-we-have-no-supplement-we-cancelled-the-supplement-there-is-only-one-paper-the-supplementary-material-of-the-writers-commits-13-and-15-is-dissolved-back-into-the-one-paper-commit-18-orde
